# GitHub Repository Metadata & SEO Configuration

Use this package to configure the GitHub repository's **About**, **Topics**, and **Social Preview** settings for maximum discovery, SEO indexing, and developer conversion.

---

## 1. Repository Description (About)
Paste into the **Description** field in GitHub repository settings (under 350 characters):

```text
Ultra-fast, zero-assembly parallel download accelerator for Windows built with Rust (Tauri v2) and React. Features true direct I/O sparse file allocation (0ms finish), Native Messaging browser interception, OLE drag-and-drop, and 4K media extraction. Modern lightweight alternative to IDM.
```

*Character count: 279 / 350 characters.*
